training_mixture: 50% clean; 25% circular AWGN uniformly at -5/0/5/10/15/20 dB; 25% mild/severe multipath uniformly; epoch-dependent deterministic draw
controlled_change: Compared with ku-leuven-augmented-local-development-v1, the only training-factor change is adding -5 dB to the AWGN level set. Branch probabilities, multipath profiles, model, optimizer, clean-validation checkpoint selection, data, and seeds are unchanged.
checkpoint_selection: unchanged: maximum clean validation recording macro-F1 then minimum clean validation loss
comparison: all 40 previously frozen validation stress conditions, all three paired model seeds and each ensemble

acceptance.clean: candidate mean recording macro-F1 across three model seeds must be at least prior augmented mean minus 0.03
acceptance.awgn_minus5_to_5_db: candidate mean -5/0/5 dB recording macro-F1 across model seeds and perturbation repeats must improve over the prior augmented experiment
acceptance.multipath_guardrail: candidate mean mild/severe multipath recording macro-F1 across model seeds and repeats must be at least prior augmented mean minus 0.03
